thinking: Thinking: Evaluated Karen Bass ordering police to stop issuing criminal citations to unpermitted street vendors in LA. Stated claim frames this as protecting working families and vendors from criminal records. Actual reality shows policy pandering, alienating licensed businesses paying high permit and tax fees, and creating unequal enforcement. Stated forces lean toward Good Preference (GP) and Greater Good (GG) protection of livelihoods. Actual forces lean toward Lesser Evil (LE) and Bad Preference (BP) due to regulatory erosion and unfair burden on legal operators. Calculated real_u = -0.5, real_psi = -0.6. R_net calculated at 2.5 (Partially Distorted). Hypocrisy gap 0.8 (Fail).
subject: Mayor Karen Bass Orders Cops to Stop Issuing Criminal Citations to Street Vendors
posts:
LA Mayor Karen Bass orders police to stop criminal citations for unpermitted street vendors, sparking outrage from taxpaying local businesses.
Evidence: protecting vendors, unfair enforcement, political pandering
#Aletheia #USPol

Proponents claim the directive prevents unfair criminalization of hardworking street vendors struggling to support their families.
Stated Judgement: (+0.8, +0.5) — Good Preference

In reality, granting blanket immunity to unpermitted vendors penalizes licensed businesses paying high annual permit, tax, and insurance fees.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.5, -0.6) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
A politically motivated policy exemption creates unfair market conditions, punishing compliant vendors while rewarding rule-breakers.

Integrity: Partially Distorted (Hypocrisy: 2.5, z: 2)

- Karen Bass / LAPD Directive: COND (-0.4, -0.5) — Shields vendors but undermines legal parity.
- Licensed Businesses: FAIL (-0.7, -0.6) — Bears regulatory costs alone.
Los Angeles Mayor Karen Bass directed the LAPD to halt criminal citations for unpermitted street vendors, aiming to protect informal workers but frustrating licensed storefronts.

The Bright Side:
Vulnerable street vendors avoid unfair criminal records for trying to make an honest living.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confusing WHAT (enforcing sidewalk safety and licensing equity) with WHO (protecting favored groups while penalizing law-abiding taxpaying competitors).

Social Physics Analysis:
By issuing unilateral exemptions for political convenience rather than reforming the burdensome licensing system transparently, the administration shifts strain onto rule-abiding merchants.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the stated goal of fairness against the unequal reality, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Systemic shortcuts undermine public trust and equity.

The Unavoidable Truth: Exempting unpermitted vendors from rules punishes legal business owners.
The Unavoidable Lie: Calling chaotic rule-breaking an equitable support program.

Alethekanon:
Suspending criminal citations without fixing the broken permit process creates a two-tiered system that pits working class vendors against taxpaying shop owners.

Awwthekanon:
Every family deserves a way to earn a living without fear, but we must also build systems that honor and protect those who follow the rules.

Brothekanon:
Wild how you can pay thousands in permits and taxes just to watch someone across the street operate totally tax-free with zero consequences.

Spirithekanon:
"Better a dish of green herbs where love is than a fattened ox and hatred with it" Proverbs 15:17 PASS
Trying to help one group by penalizing another breeds deep community resentment rather than true harmony.
